dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: This dataset represents the activity of waste disposal of waste concrete in a construction waste landfill. Recommended use of this dataset: For waste concrete material going to landfill. Can be used for /reinforced/ concrete or /not reinforced/ concrete. For the former, the mass without the reinforcement steel must be inventoried with this dataset, and the reinforcement steel additionally and separately with a steel to construction waste landfill dataset.Inventoried waste consists of fraction: 100% Concrete; . technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
This is an inventory for a construction waste landfill (mostly mineral C&D waste, VVEA type B). Ultimate average landfill height is 11 meters. Operation phase duration is 15 years.

# Included processes
Waste-specific short-term emissions via landfill leachate. Waste-specific long-term emissions from landfill. Land transformation and occupation. Waste placement and compaction. Landfill construction materials, sewer pipe for leachate, and access road.

referenceToDataSource.common:shortDescription: 2020 - LCI exc. mat. constr. and dem. waste landfill - Doka

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Landfill model based on average mineral building waste composition and observed average leachate concentrations from various literature sources. Extrapolated to 60'000 years heeding chemical characteristics and hydrology. Based on waste composition and climate data the end of carbonate phase of this landfill is estimated to be reached beyond 60'000 years.
